name: universal-mcp-toolkit
stderr:
Usage: universal-mcp-toolkit [options] [command]

A polished control plane for the universal-mcp-toolkit MCP server monorepo.

Options:
  -V, --version                     output the version number
  --no-update-check                 Disable the automatic update check on
                                    startup.
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]                    List every available MCP server in the
                                    toolkit.
  tools                             Discover and inspect MCP tools exposed by
                                    servers in the toolkit.
  task                              Manage long-running MCP tasks (2026-07-28
                                    Tasks extension: spawn, poll, await,
                                    cancel).
  workflow                          Validate and run sequential JSON MCP
                                    workflows.
  compose [options]                 Call a tool on one MCP server and pipe its
                                    output into a tool on another server.
                                    Specify as: --from <server1:tool1> --to
                                    <server2:tool2> --args '{"param": "value"}'.
  discover [options]                Scan local node_modules and npx for MCP
                                    servers with well-known manifests
                                    (.well-known/mcp-server.json). Lists
                                    discovered servers not in the built-in
                                    registry. Use --remote + --url for direct
                                    HTTP discovery or --registry for an MCP
                                    Registry endpoint.
  config [options]                  Generate a host configuration snippet for
                                    one or more servers.
  install [options]                 Interactively generate and write a host
                                    config file, then save the install profile.
  run [options] <serverId>          Run one of the local workspace server
                                    packages.
  doctor [options] [serverId]       Check build outputs and required environment
                                    variables.
  update                            Check for updates and optionally install the
                                    latest version from npm.
  test <serverId>                   Run a live end-to-end test of a server via
                                    stdio transport.
  conformance [serverId]            Check registry config generation and live
                                    stdio handshakes where build output exists.
  vet [options] <server-id-or-url>  Live-vet a running MCP server: protocol
                                    negotiation, tool-poisoning scan,
                                    permission-risk tiering, drift pin. Exit 0
                                    clean, 1 security findings, 2 protocol
                                    error.
  add [options] <server-id-or-url>  Register a server with UMT (for `doctor
                                    --vet`), with a non-blocking vet advisory
                                    first.
  export [options]                  Export install profiles to a portable JSON
                                    file (without secret values).
  profile                           Manage saved install profiles.
  status                            Show currently running umt server processes.
  logs [options] <serverName>       Tail the log file for a specific server.
  upgrade [options] [serverName]    Check npm registry for newer versions and
                                    upgrade.
  init                              Interactive setup wizard for new users.
  search <query>                    Search available servers by name,
                                    description, and tags.
  export-config [options]           Export current server configuration in
